queries.query: In Charleston, where does someone appeal an administrative decision about a sidewalk cafe permit?
queries.evidence: Board of Zoning Appeals Site Design
accepted_answers: Board of Zoning Appeals Site Design
queries.answer:
Jurisdiction: Charleston, South Carolina | District: not specified | Document version: Supplement No. 25, November 2025 | Source: Charleston, SC Zoning.pdf
To appeal an administrative decision about a sidewalk cafe permit in Charleston, you must file the appeal within ten (10) business days after actual notice of the decision, and the appeal must be filed on a form approved by the Board, which can be obtained from the City of Charleston Department of Planning and Preservation, 75 Calhoun Street, Charleston, South Carolina. [1]
